Lookup in our mappings vpc_id = subnet_to_vpc.get(subnet_id) if vpc_id and vpc_id in vpc_info: is_default = vpc_info[vpc_id]["isDefault"] vpc_type = f"{'Default VPC' if is_default else 'Custom VPC'} ({vpc_id})" else: vpc_type = "Unknown" is_default = None if not is_default: non_default_instances.append({ "name": inst["name"], "aws_id": inst["aws_id"], "region": inst["region"], "vpc_type": vpc_type }) # Print results print(f"Total EC2 Instances: {len(instances)}") print(f"Instances NOT in Default VPC: {len(non_default_instances)}\n") for inst in sorted(non_default_instances, key=lambda x: (x["region"], x["name"])): print(f"• {inst['name']}") print(f" AWS Instance ID: {inst['aws_id']}") print(f" Region: {inst['region']}") print(f" VPC: {inst['vpc_type']}") print() EOF python3 /tmp/final_analysis.py
